title: Super Metroid

masks.why: the energy, missiles and map display are BG3 laid out for 256 columns on a 32-tile map that would repeat

issues: The game draws only inside the current room: near a room's left or right wall, the side columns show the patterned tiles that lie beyond the room.
Rooms are drawn as Samus scrolls: on entering a room the sides can show old tiles for a moment.
The status display's sides are left empty (BG3 filled in rows 0-31).
